notes: Medium. Requires authoring a reusable CLI that (1) computes an exact contiguous three-way even split (offset/count arithmetic) of a row-major tensor, (2) emits a SHA-256 integrity manifest, (3) reconstructs and independently re-verifies shape, count and checksum in join mode, and (4) rejects several classes of malformed inputs (count mismatch, negative dimension, missing key, non-int values). Hidden cases force generalization across non-divisible counts, multi-dim shapes, N<3/N==0 empties, and negative values; the join path must reconstruct hidden tensors byte-for-byte. Moderate reasoning depth (split arithmetic + verify invariants) and adversarial/hidden generalization push it to the low end of medium; no resource or interaction pressure.
